entries.title: Identifying a signal's support
entries.description: determine the interval where a signal is nonzero or where a particular branch applies.

entries.title: Substituting expressions into a signal argument
entries.description: replace $t$ with expressions like $t-1$, $3t$, or $-t$ inside a signal formula.

entries.title: Simplifying transformed expressions
entries.description: rewrite substituted formulas cleanly, especially when exponential terms are involved.

entries.title: Solving interval inequalities after substitution
entries.description: transform time intervals correctly after substitution, including reversing inequalities when multiplying by $-1$.

entries.title: Tracking key time points under transformation
entries.description: identify start points, endpoints, and feature locations, then determine how they move on the time axis.
